verses.text: Praise di Lord. Praise di Lord from di heavens. Praise am for di heights.
Praise am, all im angels. Praise am, all im army.
Praise am, sun and moon. Praise am, all una shining stars.
Praise am, una heavens of heavens, and una waters wey dey above di sky.
Make dem praise di name of di Lord, because e command, and dem create.
E don establish dem forever and ever. E don make decree wey no go pass away.
Praise di Lord from di earth, una sea monsters and all deeps,
fire and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind wey dey do im word,
mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
wild animals and all livestock, creeping things and flying birds,
kings of di earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of di earth,
both young men and young women, old men and pikin dem.
Make dem praise di name of di Lord, because im name alone dey exalted. Im glory dey above di earth and di heavens.
E don raise up horn for im people, praise of all im holy ones, even of di pikin dem of Israel, people wey near am. Praise di Lord.
Praise di Lord. Sing to di Lord new song, im praise for di assembly of di holy ones.
Make Israel rejoice for im Maker. Make di pikin dem of Zion be glad for dem King.
Make dem praise im name with dancing. Make dem sing praises to am with tambourine and harp.
Because di Lord take pleasure for im people. E go beautify di humble with salvation.
Make di holy ones rejoice for glory. Make dem sing for joy on dem beds.
Make high praises of God dey for dem mouth and two edged sword for dem hand,
to execute vengeance on di nations and punishment on di peoples,
to bind dem kings with chains and dem nobles with iron shackles,
to execute on dem di judgment wey dem don write. Dis honor na for all im holy ones. Praise di Lord.
Praise di Lord. Praise God for im sanctuary. Praise am for di heavens of im power.
Praise am for im mighty acts. Praise am according to im excellent greatness.
Praise am with di sound of di trumpet. Praise am with harp and lyre.
Praise am with tambourine and dancing. Praise am with strings and flute.
Praise am with loud cymbals. Praise am with clashing cymbals.
Make everything wey get breath praise di Lord. Praise di Lord.
